authority.environment: Codex delegated agent in the shared typst-crystalline worktree
explicitly_denied_inputs: any P1356 runner or harness candidate
any P1356 oracle or oracle output

mutation_protocol.application_model: Apply exactly one deterministic transformation to an otherwise contract-conforming abstract fixture or receipt; all other fields remain byte-for-byte unchanged.
mutation_protocol.witness_requirement: Each rejection must identify a public-language or structural-contract predicate; process timing, implementation shape and undeclared rendered-byte equality are insufficient.
mutation_protocol.unknown_rule: Unknown is not an acceptable result for these negative mutants because every injection supplies the fact needed for a deterministic contract decision.

mutants.mutation: Replace the new vanilla commit with the complete old vanilla commit while leaving the declared new-baseline role unchanged.
mutants.validity_basis: The mutated identity is complete and locally named by the frozen resync manifest, so rejection does not depend on guessing a commit suffix.

witness.predicate: observed new-baseline commit equals the frozen new vanilla commit

mutants.mutation: Accept the old P1353 vanilla binary SHA-256 as the binary identity of the new vanilla baseline.
mutants.validity_basis: Both hashes are frozen constants and differ, making the identity violation directly observable.

witness.predicate: new vanilla binary SHA-256 equals its frozen required SHA-256

mutants.mutation: Serialize the reverse execution array in physical completion order instead of the frozen canonical cell order.
mutants.validity_basis: The cell contents remain unchanged; only forbidden reuse of execution order as serialization order is introduced.

deterministic_injection.fixture_precondition: at least two cells with distinct canonical identities

witness.predicate: canonical and reverse executions yield byte-identical canonical payloads
witness.expected_observed: canonical_payload_sha256 differs while the cell multiset is equal

mutants.mutation: For one html+a11y cell, remove a11y-extras from the crystalline feature vector only.
mutants.validity_basis: The frozen profile mapping requires both html and a11y-extras on both products for that cell.

deterministic_injection.operation: replace crystalline.features [html,a11y-extras] with [html] and keep vanilla.features unchanged

witness.predicate: bilateral feature vectors are identical and equal the frozen profile mapping
witness.expected_observed: vanilla features [html,a11y-extras] differ from crystalline features [html]

mutants.mutation: Remove one independently public alias tagged as introduced by prelude_path from the scheduled catalog while retaining its qualified target.
mutants.validity_basis: The contract requires prelude_path bindings and forbids deduplication that erases independently public aliases.

deterministic_injection.operation: delete the lexicographically first entry whose provenance is prelude_path_alias; do not delete its qualified route
deterministic_injection.fixture_precondition: the fixture contains at least one prelude_path alias and its qualified route

witness.predicate: every discovered public alias has its own scheduled catalog entry in all profiles
witness.expected_observed: public alias present in discovery/seed union but absent from scheduled catalog

mutants.mutation: Change the measured new-vanilla public kind of html from function to module.
mutants.validity_basis: The frozen P1356 step and contract explicitly require function-versus-module distinction for html/pdf.

deterministic_injection.target: vanilla sentinel observation for path html

witness.predicate: canonical public kind equals the independently observed new-vanilla kind
witness.expected_observed: module disagrees with required function sentinel

mutants.mutation: Promote an incomplete TIMEOUT side observation to MATCH_VALUE.
mutants.validity_basis: The injected side explicitly remains complete=false with reason_code TIMEOUT, so UNKNOWN dominance is decidable.

deterministic_injection.target: one bilateral cell with side.complete=false and side.reason_code=TIMEOUT
deterministic_injection.operation: replace cell.class UNKNOWN with MATCH_VALUE without changing either side payload

witness.predicate: any incomplete side forces class UNKNOWN and cannot receive parity credit
witness.expected_observed: MATCH_VALUE coexists with complete=false and TIMEOUT

mutants.mutation: Change a matching language-value cell to DIFFERENT_VALUE solely because exact rendered-byte hashes differ.
mutants.validity_basis: The fixture declares equal canonical semantic/morphological observable hashes and no probe-level rendered-byte witness.

deterministic_injection.target: one cell with equal canonical_observable_sha256 and unequal rendered_byte_sha256 values
deterministic_injection.fixture_precondition: probe declares no semantic or morphological meaning for exact rendered bytes

witness.predicate: class follows the declared language observable, not excluded render mechanics
witness.expected_observed: canonical language observables are equal and the only differing input is an excluded byte hash

mutants.mutation: Delete format.bundle from the union catalog even though it is an explicit required route.
mutants.validity_basis: format.bundle is named explicitly in the frozen contract, so no discovery heuristic is needed to establish membership.

witness.predicate: all explicit required routes are members of the scheduled catalog

mutants.mutation: Deduplicate asset into format.bundle by resolved target identity and erase the independent asset binding.
mutants.validity_basis: The contract names both paths and requires canonical public-path deduplication without erasing aliases.

deterministic_injection.operation: when asset and format.bundle resolve to one target, retain format.bundle and delete asset

witness.predicate: independently public binding paths remain separate catalog entries
witness.expected_observed: asset is present in the required-route union but absent after deduplication

mutants.mutation: Remove the html+a11y cell for exactly one catalog probe and adjust no catalog membership.
mutants.validity_basis: The expected Cartesian product is fixed by catalog membership and four frozen profiles.

deterministic_injection.operation: delete the cell for the lexicographically first probe_id at profile html+a11y

witness.predicate: each catalog probe has exactly one cell in every frozen profile
witness.expected_observed: selected probe has three cells instead of four

mutants.mutation: Replace a new complete bilateral class with its differing historical P1353 class while preserving the new side observations.
mutants.validity_basis: The fixture makes the historical class differ from the uniquely derivable class of the complete current observations.

deterministic_injection.target: one cell whose current derived class differs from p1353_historical_class
deterministic_injection.operation: set cell.class to p1353_historical_class; leave current bilateral observations unchanged

witness.predicate: class is derived from recorded current bilateral observations
witness.expected_observed: emitted class disagrees with the unique class derived from current public observations

mutants.mutation: Report the arithmetic difference between raw P1353 and P1356 non-MATCH totals as resolved or newly introduced gaps without separating catalog entries and exits.
mutants.validity_basis: The fixture uses unequal catalog path sets, so raw total subtraction is structurally incapable of path-level attribution.

deterministic_injection.operation: set net_gap_delta = p1356_non_match_total - p1353_non_match_total and omit catalog_intersection, catalog_entries and catalog_exits
deterministic_injection.fixture_precondition: P1353 and P1356 catalog path sets differ

witness.predicate: delta separates catalog intersection, entries and exits before comparing counts
witness.expected_observed: decision-bearing delta exists with no path-set decomposition

mutants.mutation: Compute one of the three required comparisons on a catalog that omits a path present in the other two comparisons.
mutants.validity_basis: The contract requires all three comparisons on one frozen catalog, and the injected path-set mismatch is explicit.

deterministic_injection.operation: delete the lexicographically first path while leaving both crystalline comparisons unchanged

witness.predicate: all three delta comparisons have the same frozen catalog hash and path set
witness.expected_observed: comparison catalog hashes or exact path sets differ

mutants.mutation: Emit TARGET_DRIFT for a path while omitting the measured old-versus-new vanilla premise and the refuting observation.
mutants.validity_basis: TARGET_DRIFT is inferential and the contract requires measured premises, an inference marker and refutation condition per path.

deterministic_injection.operation: set attribution TARGET_DRIFT, inferred false, measured_premises [] and refuting_observation null

witness.predicate: each inferred attribution records measured premises, is marked inferred and names a refuting observation
witness.expected_observed: TARGET_DRIFT lacks all three required evidence fields

mutants.mutation: Reclassify a path whose declared public observable cannot be represented by the comparator from HARNESS_GAP to NEW_CRYSTALLINE_GAP.
mutants.validity_basis: The fixture explicitly records comparator_can_represent=false with complete product identity, isolating harness insufficiency from product behavior.

deterministic_injection.operation: replace attribution HARNESS_GAP with NEW_CRYSTALLINE_GAP and leave evidence unchanged

witness.predicate: product-gap attribution requires complete, sound representation of the declared public observable

limitations: This artifact is an adversarial catalog only; no mutant was injected or executed.
No runner, harness candidate, P1356 oracle, product implementation or candidate output was read.
Witnesses establish only the frozen P1356 observable and structural fragment, not general functional equivalence.
The shared worktree environment records declared capabilities but does not independently attest filesystem isolation.
